That argues for a high share of the room presenting. Against that, the 3,000 headcount explicitly includes staff from 189 exhibitors, a student/STEM contingent with its own destination in the exhibit hall, a job fair, and the large DOE-complex and contractor attendance that comes to this meeting for programme business rather than to present. Judged at 35%, reasoning from the counted engineering rows with both numbers: INFORMS sits near 79% (5,122 on ~6,500) as a pure academic congress with a one-presentation-per-person rule; SAE WCX at ~16% (776 on 4,800 registered) as an industry congress with an exhibition; TRB at ~9% (981 on 11,000, and that figure is posters only, with 31% of the headcount public-sector staff at committee meetings). WM is much more paper-driven than TRB or WCX because its proceedings is the point, but far less so than INFORMS because a third of the room is industry and agency staff rather than authors - 35% places it between WCX and INFORMS and nearer the middle. 3,000 x 0.35 = ~1,050. The relative +/-20% flex band is 28-42%, giving 840-1,260, whose top comfortably clears the 900 bar.
method: RUNG 9 (attendance pass), ONE search - the abstract ladder is genuinely exhausted and the reason is a CREDENTIAL wall, not a bot wall. Rungs 3-6 were worked in full. The society site wmsym.org has no programme; its 'Archives' link redirects to https://archivedproceedings.econference.io/wmsym/, which returns HTTP 500 with a raw Lucee stack trace ('MissingIncludeException: Page /wmsym/templates/default---old-non-bootstrap/website_jheader.cfm not found') - the host root serves the default Lucee welcome page, so this is a BROKEN SERVER, not a wall: a browser fails identically and it must NOT be queued for rung 5. https://www.xcdsystem.com/wmsym/ 302s to /member/ and the programme endpoint /wmsym/program/C3Ythxg/ returns 149 bytes reading 'conference timezone not set.'. ONE search located the live archive https://www.xcdsystem.com/wmsym/2024/index.cfm, which IS open and carries the president's post-meeting letter with the figures - but every one of its proceedings pages (sessions.cfm, FinalProgram.cfm, authors.cfm, attendees.cfm) returns 'NOTE: You must login to access the proceedings.' That is a credential wall, which the brief excludes from rung 5, and older editions are behind the broken Lucee archive, so no open artefact exists for any edition. Hence rung 9. Curran/proceedings.com was checked for a print proceedings and carries none. Excluded from the conversion basis: nothing was subtracted from the 3,000 headcount, because the source gives no breakdown - the exhibitor and student contingents are instead handled inside the judged ratio, and that is stated rather than hidden.
